name: obsidian-auto-link-creator
description: Automatically creates Obsidian links from list templates, repeated phrases, and NLP keyword detection. Suggests links across the vault with a preview before applying.

scripts.sync: mkdir -p ../../../Plugin/Link && rsync -rtuv --exclude AGENTS.md ./docs/ ../../../Plugin/Link/ && rsync -rtuv --exclude AGENTS.md ../../../Plugin/Link/ ./docs/ && rsync -rtuv ./AGENTS.md ../../../Plugin/Link/AGENTS.md && rsync -rtuv ../../../Plugin/Link/AGENTS.md ./AGENTS.md
scripts.build: npm run sync && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
